@ the output reads 0, 1, 2, … from the first frame
@ the count goes on across calls, and a call of 0 frames does not count
@ a state of its own starts at 0 and the count of the other state is not read
@ reset gives 0 again, as init does
@ read in a stage of sample / 4 it is the number of frames, not of the ticks of that stage
@ the difference of two reads in a stage of sample / 4 is 4 with t -% last
@ the value at sample less the value of the last tick of sample / 4 is the frame in the tick
@ as the first argument of a delay it is the count of the frame, delayed
@ in a par the count is the same for every replica
@ the count mixes with a sample input, whatever the blocks are
